terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: A LIVING FIGURE authored in one fixed sleeping pose: the kit carries no rig and no animation, so nothing articulates, nothing attaches, and one root pivot with zero sockets is the whole contract. subject=animal selects the generic profile; primaryDomain is kept at object because the validator's hybrid contract demands the HUMAN anatomy block (styleHeads, faceLandmarks from MediaPipe), which has nothing to say about a dog -- the animal handling is the chirality and swept-arc reasoning recorded in assumptions. Every shophouse front and temple yard at midday. Tan and white short coat, a dark muzzle, pink-scabbed patches, dusty pads, ears folded flat in sleep.

reasoning: ONE body merge -- a 31-station Catmull-Rom-subdivided tube from tail root to occiput (16 segments), two ellipsoid thighs laid hip-to-stifle, four shank / foreleg polyline tubes with joint balls at elbow and hock, four paw ovals with dark toe-pad caps, a two-piece tail with a bend ball and a rounded tip -- with an axis tint from tan on the back (-X) to cream on the belly and legs (+X): ONE draw call. ONE head merge -- a skull dome and occiput (ellipsoids), a 19-station muzzle tube deeper than it is wide, a nose pad, two extruded ear flaps, a closed-eye slit and a mouth line -- with a darkening mask multiplier from the stop to the nose: ONE draw call. TWO of 4.
One material: short fur as vertex colours on white, with a 512 px fur canvas (directional hair strokes, cloudy drift, three bare patches) bound after construction as map and bump.
No repetition system: four legs differ in position, height and joint angle.
Action readiness: one root pivot, zero sockets, one convex collider, not breakable; no rig by design.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The identity is a long low lump with a tan back, a white belly, four legs stretched out to one side and a head laid flat with folded ears -- a lying pose that reads without a rig; what separates a DOG from a pig or a sausage is a domed skull with a stop, a muzzle deeper than wide, ear flaps at the rear of the skull on the dorsal side, a lean ribcage and jointed legs, so the body and muzzle are station tubes and the skull, thighs, paws and joints are ellipsoids.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py. See grimoire/character/reconstruction.md and grimoire/character/likeness_maximization.md.

resolvedUnknowns: Lying pose only: no rig, no standing variant; the registry notes say so.

Chirality: the two forelegs and two hind legs are not mirrored pairs here -- lying on its side both legs of a pair point the same way, the upper (left) one higher and tailward as the plate shows; validate_chirality has no -l/-r pair to test and the swept-arc claim is the tail's curve, carried as a two-piece polyline with a bend ball.

The ears: the left (upper) ear is folded over the top-rear of the skull and draped dorsally and back over the neck, the right (lower) ear lies flat on the ground under the skull on the dorsal side -- both at the REAR of the skull, never on the throat side.
Fur is one material with an axis tint and a fur canvas; the plate's pink patches are three soft bare patches on the tile.
preSpecAssessment.unknownsResolutionNote: Emptied because every entry has been RESOLVED with a recorded authoring decision, not because the gaps went away. Each is restated in assumptions and in viewEvidence with its confidence and a null path. Nothing was invented to close a gap.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 0.35 x 0.28 x 0.95 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=4000 triangles, <=4 draw calls, <=6 materials, <=6 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot plus 0 named mechanism pivot(s); zero sockets; convex collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

coordinateFrame.notes: Origin base-center on the ground, +Y up, +Z the HEAD end, the dog lying on its RIGHT side with its legs stretched toward +X, its back toward -X and its left flank up.

silhouette.description: A 0.957 m long, 0.16 m high lump lying along Z: rump and ribcage 0.19 deep tapering to a 0.11 neck at +Z, a 0.22 m head with a 0.148 x 0.128 skull dome, a boxy dark muzzle and two ear flaps at +Z, four jointed legs 0.19 m out to +X lying flat with pads, a tail trailing 0.13 m past the rump to -Z.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: SECOND BUILD (quality pass). The first shipped a spindle body pinching into a conical snout with box ears, one of them on the throat side: it read as a pig with its head upside down. This build authors the anatomy DIRECTLY in the declared box, no per-component scale: the body sits 45 mm dorsal of the origin so the back is at x -0.145 and the paw pads at +0.21, the length is 0.957 nose to tail. Plate read at ~1.01 mm per px (nose x 60 to tail tip x 1000 = 0.95 m): head x 60-225 (0.165 foreshortened, authored 0.22 occiput to nose), body shoulder-to-rump x 225-830 (0.60), back line y 325-350 withers to loin, chest 200 px of image depth against the HEAD's 195 -- which is the evidence for a LEAN body: a 0.19 m deep, 0.15 m thick ribcage rather than the first build's 0.32 x 0.26, and a 0.148 x 0.128 skull. Built height 0.16 m at the barrel against the declared 0.28: the declaration is a fat dog and the plate is not; the h is reported, not scaled to. Forelegs leave the chest at x 280-300 and reach paws at x 330/390, y 690, both angled tailward; hind legs leave the hip at x 700 for paws at x 760/830, y 640, extended back with a hock bend; upper ear folded over the top-rear of the skull at x 150-195 standing 10-20 px proud of the head outline; lower ear on the ground beside the forehead at x 55-85. NO Meshy proxy: fal's content checker refused the plate twice (422 content_policy_violation, scratch/sleeping-soi-dog/meshgen.log and meshgen.refused.log; the endpoint forces enable_safety_checker true), so there is no band table and the single plate is the only evidence.
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: NO PROXY: fal returned 422 content_policy_violation on the plate twice (once with enable_safety_checker=false requested; the endpoint echoes it back as true). Stations were read off the plate alone at ~1 mm per px; no band table exists and the length-to-depth ratio carries the plate's foreshortening (confidence 0.75). The lean-body call rests on the plate's head-depth to chest-depth ratio (195 : 200 px).

viewEvidence.note: NOT DIRECTLY OBSERVED. Confidence 0.75: the dog's back (-X) and the underside it lies on are inferred from the class; the tan saddle is carried over the whole back.
NOT MEASURED: no proxy, so the length-to-depth ratio is the plate's three-quarter read; the body depth is set from the head-to-chest image-depth ratio.

componentTree.name: Body, legs and tail
componentTree.topologyRationale: One 31-station tube, two thigh ellipsoids, four leg tubes, joint balls, paw ovals and a tail merged on one material: one draw call, authored directly in the declared box.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: Stations [z, cx, cy, rx, ry] from the tail root at -0.352 to the occiput at 0.305, 11 authored and Catmull-Rom subdivided x3, 16 segments; ribcage rx 0.100 ry 0.080 at z 0.03; forelegs r 0.029 from the chest to paws at x 0.168; thighs as ellipsoids r 0.042 / 0.047 hip to stifle; shanks r 0.026 over a hock; tail r 0.022 to 0.015 ending at -0.463; paws 0.042 x 0.033 x 0.035 with a pad cap.
geometryDescriptor.zFightingNote: Legs and thighs enter the body tube as interpenetrating solids; joint balls swallow the cylinder caps; paw ovals cover the leg ends; the tail enters the rump. Nothing planar meets: check-coplanar clean at 0.001 m.
geometryDescriptor.mergeNote: One merged BufferGeometry with world UVs at 0.30 m.

localFeatures.delivery: thigh ellipsoids + tubes + joint balls + paw ovals

colorMaterialRecipe.recipe: Tan-to-cream axis tint on white fur with a fur canvas; pads grey.

componentTree.name: Head, ears and nose
componentTree.topologyRationale: Two skull ellipsoids, one station tube, one nose ellipsoid, two extruded ear flaps and two boxes merged on the same material: one draw call.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: Skull dome 0.148 x 0.128 x 0.160 centred at z 0.32 on the ground; occiput ball blending into the neck; muzzle stations from 0.345 (inside the skull) to the nose at 0.4745, rx 0.052 -> 0.024 and ry 0.036 -> 0.019, 19 stations x 12 segments, drooping to the throat side; nose pad 0.038 x 0.034 x 0.030; upper ear 0.085 x 0.060 flap based ON the skull surface at its top-dorsal-rear and draped dorsally and back; lower ear 0.072 x 0.052 flat on the ground under the dorsal side of the skull; a closed-eye slit 0.005 x 0.024 on the up face behind the stop; a mouth line along the ventral edge of the muzzle.
geometryDescriptor.zFightingNote: The muzzle tube starts inside the skull dome; the occiput ball sits inside the neck tube; ears stand on the skull surface as interpenetrating solids; the nose overlaps the muzzle end; the eye and mouth line stand 2 mm proud of curved surfaces.

localFeatures.delivery: skull ellipsoids + muzzle tube + ear extrudes + boxes

colorMaterialRecipe.recipe: Skull tan with a darkening mask multiplier from the stop to the nose along Z; ears, nose, eye and mouth line tinted.

actionProfile.notes: Rigidly parented to the root. NO pivot and NO socket, deliberately: this part does not move and nothing attaches to it.

roughness.notes: Scalar observed for this surface in the plate. The independently extracted map is kept on disk as evidence and is NOT bound at runtime -- this material is textureless, so the scalar is the runtime value.

albedo.samplingNotes: Measured as the mean of crops/tan.png. extract_pbr_evidence confidence 0.840. The extractor palette is advisory only: these crops are flat material swatches, not isolated objects, so its foreground separation is weak by its own warnings. Albedo is the direct crop measurement.

localOverrides.evidence: crops/belly.png -- #6b635a grey-brown dust on the underside; the fur canvas drift.

evidence: Measured on viewEvidence region-tan (0.84) at #b8a28a (the tan saddle in flat light) and region-white at #b5aa9f; carried as an axis tint from #b98a55 on the back to #d8d2c8 on the belly and legs, skull #a8804f off the plate's #9b7956, muzzle mask a x0.49 multiplier off region-muzzle #8a7c70 against the skull, pads #7a7370 off region-paw, on a WHITE material.
Textureless as DECLARED: a 512 px fur canvas (5,200 directional hair strokes, cloudy drift, three bare patches) bound after construction as map and bump.
textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. It is also a correctness fix: with a texture set the generator forces color to white and roughness to 1 and reads both from the generated maps, discarding this measured albedo.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the large class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: Two components, no repetition system: 2 of 4.

materials.note: fur only: 1 of 6; the coat is an axis tint and a fur canvas.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 3,932 of 4,000: a 31-station body tube and a 19-station muzzle tube, five ellipsoid solids, twelve joint / paw / tail balls, six leg and tail tubes, two ear extrudes, two boxes.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: Catmull-Rom-subdivided station tubes for the body and muzzle; ellipsoids for the skull, occiput, nose, thighs, joints, paws and tail knots; polyline tubes for shanks, forelegs and tail; extruded rounded-triangle flaps for the ears; boxes for the eye slit and mouth line.
No InstancedMesh. In a scene the HOST instances the dog.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.
The material is declared textureless. One 512 px fur canvas after construction as map and bump, 1 MB.

risks.description: No Meshy proxy: the content checker refuses the plate, so proportions are the plate's foreshortened read with no band table.
risks.mitigation: Recorded; confidence 0.75 on the length-to-depth ratio; the lean body follows the plate's head-to-chest depth ratio. A second plate or a hand-measured reference would close it.

risks.description: Built 0.16 m high at the barrel against a declared 0.28: the declaration describes a fatter dog than the plate shows.
risks.mitigation: Reported on the asset; the declaration is the asset list's to change.
